answer: New identities arrive at the wharf with an empty crystal and must grow it layer by layer before gaining full rights. Each layer needs a sequential proof chained to the previous layer plus that epoch's fresh lantern value, published by unrelated established agents — so layers cannot be built in parallel or precomputed, and a lantern value expires after one epoch. Growing a trusted crystal takes N epochs of sequential work per identity; a farm of k clones must grow k crystals, paying k times N epochs, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its crystal forever.
